name: 凌霜
negative_extra_cn: 艳俗、甜美可爱、杂乱配饰、风尘气

stand.desc_cn: 侧身约30°，下颌微抬，目光侧前，双手自然垂落身侧，玉箫悬于腰间，疏离清冷
stand.desc_en: side stance about 30 degrees, slightly raised chin, gaze to the side, hands resting at sides, jade flute at waist, detached and cold

halfbody.desc_cn: 半身像，侧身微抬颌，一手轻执玉箫抵于唇边作吹奏施法状，衣袖垂落，气态疏冷
halfbody.desc_en: half-body, slight side turn with raised chin, one hand lightly holding the jade flute to the lips as if playing a spell, sleeves draping, cold demeanor
